component.text: Swabs collect surface material. Petri dishes expose reactions. Tubes and syringes carry blood. Blood slides provide microscope input. Culture vials preserve a strain for cultivation and research.
A sample carries its blood, infection and strain data through compatible containers. Sterility does not erase legitimate analysis data, but contaminated equipment can compromise the chain.
Do not expect every container tooltip to reveal a genome. Hidden information is intentionally unlocked by laboratory analysis rather than ordinary inventory inspection.
